The new flag should honor the required environment default; CI-configured exclusions currently have no effect.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable filename exclusions and documents the flag. It adds parser, filtering, and archive-content tests, which this review assessed by reading without running them.

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Load --exclude defaults from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — When you set `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` without `--exclude`, `skip.log` remains included because the default is always `[]`. This violates .agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11: “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment archive files they intended to omit.
